# Gabe Vandevere

> Gabe Vandevere is a senior computer science student at the University of Delaware (expected spring 2027, GPA 3.87, Dean's List every semester) based in Wayne, Pennsylvania, in the Philadelphia area. He is a QA and Operations Intern at The RxAssistant, where he builds and tests AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical clients, and previously a Research and Development Intern at Westpepper Capital, where he built machine-learning backtesting pipelines and real-time crypto market-data systems. His website is served from a Jetson Orin Nano on his desk, which also runs the language model visitors can talk to.

## Education

- Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Delaware, expected 2027, GPA 3.87

## Experience

- **QA and Operations Intern, The RxAssistant** (remote; 2026-05 to present): Develops and deploys AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical clients across more than ten brands: client-facing conversational-AI prototypes and production demos, ambient listening and workflow automation, conversational AI over regulated product, access, affordability and patient-support content. Assists QA and UAT for client releases (authored and executed 100+ test cases, validated AI responses, supported deployments from staging through production). Contributes to product infrastructure including React Native setup and AWS Bedrock integration.
- **Research and Development Intern, Westpepper Capital** (Radnor, Pennsylvania; 2025-06 to 2026-02): Built an end-to-end machine-learning modeling and backtesting pipeline over earnings, guidance and analyst-estimate data (15 model variants, up to 57% next-day direction accuracy in historical tests). Designed and deployed real-time crypto order-book tracking in Java on AWS EC2 via the Kraken API across 200+ markets. Developed trading strategies, one promoted to production. Built a Python analytics pipeline and dashboard (P&L and volume aggregation, Matplotlib) used daily.

## Projects

- **Automated short-form video pipeline**: Python pipeline that scrapes scripts, generates video with audio and subtitles (whisper, MoviePy, pydub, ffmpeg) and uploads via the YouTube Data API, fully eliminating manual content creation.
- **gabevandevere.com**: This site: hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, served from an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano at home behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, with a Python proxy in front of a locally running open language model (llama.cpp) that visitors can chat with.
